verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
SIYINZA,Ayi-Omulokozi
Ow'ekitiibwa-ennyo
Siyinza,nze-omuntu-omubi
Kusuuta-erinnya lyo:
Mu ggulu bamalayika
N'abaanunulibwa
Basinza bulijjo,naye
Simanyi,nsirika.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Jjangu,-Omwoyo-Omutukuvu,
Onjigirize nze
Ekitibwa kyo n'okutya,
N'obutuukirivu;
Bwe ntyo bwe nsaanira ddala
-Okuyimba-ettendo lyo
Awamu n'abatukuvu
Ne bamalayika.
